caption: Bais Brucha Inc. v. Township of Toms River
citation_line: Bais Brucha Inc. v. Township of Toms River, No. 3:21-cv-03239, ECF No. 53 (D.N.J. Nov. 3, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Allowed supplemental federal constitutional and RLUIPA allegations concerning post-complaint zoning amendments under Rule 15(d), and separately recommended dismissal of an NJLAD land-use claim because New Jersey law assigns exclusive jurisdiction to Superior Court.
qualification_rationale: Combines supplemental pleading, religious-land-use litigation, a federal consent order, and an unusual state-law forum restriction.
appellate_posture_note: The district judge adopted the NJLAD recommendation on January 9, 2023; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_label: Religious Land Use and State Civil Rights Jurisdiction
